out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers (canned monster drink and glass of ice water) stored (food prep counter at the end of the prepline and clean kitchen equipment middle shelf) in a manner that may contaminate food and food contact surfaces.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. CDI: CFM relocated open can of Monster drink and glass of ice water to area away from food, food contact surfaces, and single-service items.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: uncleaned kitchen equipment (metal pans) and utensils stored on clean shelves (middle kitchen and across from chlorine dish machine),
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CDI: EHS instructed CFM to clean (wash, rinse, and sanitize) kitchen equipment (metal pans) and utensils before storing on clean shelves.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: shredded cabbage (47F) in bowl stored on top of 2 Dr preptop refrigerator (not stored properly) and commerically prepared vegetable spring rolls ( 47F) stored in the to part of the Everest 2 Dr preptop refrigerator (l).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM relocated shredded cabbage and commerically prepared vegetable spring rolls to walk in refrigerator to allow food to cool back to 41F or below. EHS instructed CFM t o half portion of the shredded cabbage to properly store in preptop storage to ensure proper cold holding of at least 41F or below.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials (three jugs of drain chemical substance) is not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food (baking soda) and single service items (plastic to-go containers) on shelf at the end of the cookline.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. CDI: CFM relocated the three jugs of drain chemical cleaner to area away from food, food contact, and single-service items.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: dry goods (seasoning, salt, sugar, breadcrumbs, msg) and squeeze bottles (oil, cooking wine, soy sauce) on dry storage shelf and cart near wok on the cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CDI: CFM labeled items removed from its original container with common food name.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food (box of cabbage) bulk containers of pickled radishes stored on the floor inside the walk in refrigerator and bulk chili oil stored on floor inside main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CDI: CFM relocated box of cabbage and bulk container of pickled radishes to shelf inside the walk in refrigerator. CFM relocated bulk chili oil to dry storage middle shelf.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: plastic bowls (no handle) used as scoops in bulk ingredients bins (dry rice x 2, flour) throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: CFM removed plastic bowls from bulk dry products (dry rice and flour bins).

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Plastic and metal containers were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization on shelves (middle of kitchen and shelves above the 3 vat sink).
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. CDI: CFM separated plastic and metal containers to allow to properly air dry before stacking in storage.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: metal sheet pan and rubber mat lining middle shelves (kitchen), cardboard lining shelf under front service window area.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS instructed CFM to remove metal sheet pan and rubber mat from middle shelves and cardboard from shelf under the front service window to allow for proper cleaning.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: hot water does not work at the prep sink at the the end of the cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EHS instructed CFM to schedule repair on hot water at prep sink at the end of the cookline.

violations.title: Counter-Mounted Equipment, Elevated or Sealed
violations.observation: The table-mounted hand sink (near 3 vats) and basin at the pre-scrape sprayer (chlorine dish machine) is not installed in a manner that allows for proper cleaning of the unit or the area around it and is in need a sealant.
violations.corrective_action: Counter-mounted equipment that is not easily movable shall be installed to allow cleaning of the equipment and areas underneath and around the equipment by being sealed or elevated on legs. EHS instructed CFM to seal/ caulk around hand sink (near 3 vats) and basin at the pre-scrape sprayer (chlorine dish machine) to allow for proper cleaning of the unit or the area around it.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical (chlorine ) sanitizing solutions for the chlorine dishmachine.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a @BLEACH, QUATERNARY AMMONIA, IODINE@ test kit. CDI: EHS provided chlorine tests strips and CFM obtain test strips from neighboring restaurant.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the walls and floors throughout the kitchen (ware washing area (3 vat sink) and in between/ behind equipment under and behind fryers on the cookline, and under shelves inside the walk in refrigerator) is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS instructed CFM to clean floors and walls throughout the kitchen and walk in refrigerator. HAO BY HAORU (Inspection Date: 08/03/2026) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the wall near the fryers are melting (yellow melted installation from wall is exposed)/ walls above the 3 vats has several holes and not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS instructed CFM to schedule repair on damaged walls near the fryers and above the 3 vat sink.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: Food employees WERE observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink: FOOD PREPARATION SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEES TO WASH HANDS AT THE HANDWASH SINK ONLY. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW EGGS OVER PREPARED VEGETABLES; RAW PORK OVER BEAN SPROUTS IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: EGG FRIED RICE IN EVEREST 1 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR; COOKED PORK DUMPLINGS IN WILK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO APPLY APPROPRIATE DATE MARKING DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PLACED ORDER FOR PROBE FOOD THERMOMETER DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PREPARE SANITIZER BUCKETS WITH SANITIZER SOLUTION OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION TO STORE WET WIPING CLOTHS FOR WORK STATIONS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system: AT MOP SINK FAUCET WITH HOSE AND SPRAY NOZZLE CONNECTED.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCONNECTED HOSE WITH SPRAY NOZZLE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE INSTALL APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE TO CONNECT HOSE AND SPRAY NOZZLE TO MOP SINK FAUCET.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the WALLS AND FLOORS in the KITCHEN ARE in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND IMPLEMENT AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE FOR FLOORS AND WALLS IN KITCHEN.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.observation: Observed the handsink NEAR 3 COMPARTMENT SINK being used TO CLEAN CONDIMENT BOTTLES.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO CLEAN BOTTLES AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW PORK OVER PREPARED VEGETABLES IN EVEREST 1 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR; RAW SEAFOOD OVER PREPARED VEGETABLES AND RAW SHELL EGGS AND CHICKEN OVER PREPARED VEGETABLES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours. FRIED RICE AT 72F FOR 3 HOURS IN 2 DOOR PREP TOP (RIGHT).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD RICE DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: BLACK BEAN VEGETABLE AT 121F IN STEAM TABLE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT FOODS TO 165F OR ABOVE DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: FRIED RICE AT 72F FOR 3 HOURS IN DEEP PAN IN 2 DOOR PREP TOP (RIGHT).
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE USE SHALLOW PANS, SMALLER PORTIONS IN ICE BATHS OR MAIN REFRIGERATOR TO RAPIDLY COOL FOODS FROM 135F TO 70F IN 2 HOURS AND TAO A FURTHER 41F WITHIN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC APPLIED LABELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.
